map.毕渥数 Bi = h×L ÷ k（h 为对流传热系数、L 为特征长度、k 为导热: Biot number Bi = h×L ÷ k (h convective heat transfer coefficient, L characteristic length, k thermal conductivity, expressing the ratio of internal conduction resistance to surface convection resistance). Validation: h, L and k are all required valid numbers (the required-field shell blocks invalid input). Criteria: when Bi < 0.1 the internal temperature gradient is negligible and the tool judges “lumped-capacitance method usable (Bi<0.1)”, otherwise it judges “internal temperature gradient not negligible” and distributed-parameter treatment is required.
